svg.title: Where the code lives
svg.desc: Code map: seven layers from interfaces (dashboard, CLI, SDK, plugins) through the network edge (src/net), the engine (src/engine), agents and coordination, knowledge and learning, persistence (src/persistence) and shared foundations.
svg.text: Directories grouped by role, from what people open (top) to what every part shares (bottom). A grouping, not a strict layering.
